RelateAnything is a Python library for real-time, open-vocabulary relation prediction from any input. It allows users to define custom relation predicates at inference time without retraining, and it does not require object class labels, making it highly flexible. The model can output ranked lists of relations, or both spatial and semantic graphs simultaneously.

openGym is a self-hosted, progressive web application for tracking gym workouts and body weight. It allows users to plan routines, log sets, supersets, warm-ups, and cardio, while also visualizing muscle fatigue and training progress. The application emphasizes data ownership and privacy, offering features like passkey login and import capabilities from other fitness apps.
